honest_c3_caveats: C1: tkinter unavailable in .venv-eeg python; switched to terminal-fullscreen presenter — UX contract preserved (centered text, spacebar advance, min dwell enforced) but no GUI fullscreen modal; user must run in maximized terminal window for spec-equivalent visual coverage

C2: LSL marker stream and EEG capture are SEPARATE processes; cross-process clock sync verified post-hoc by F-PHASE-E-2 (median latency <50ms target); no live sync guarantee at presenter level — if F-PHASE-E-2 FAILs, F-ARTIFACT verdict cascade per spec §2.3

C3: 280 of the 300 sentences are axis-coherent extensions (not ZuCo SR transcript) — corpus is anima-native rather than methodologically-homologous to BLM Phase 5 EEG side; user can opt-in to Source B (ZuCo SR sentence text) in a follow-up cycle if cross-substrate cross-fold-in is desired

C4: stimulus presenter does not emit audio sync pulse (spec §3 mentions 50ms 2kHz tone on AUX17 as fallback) — this prep version omits audio sync; relies on LSL marker stream alone; recommend adding audio pulse in v2 if sync verification fails post-session

C5: collect.hexa is invoked with direct BrainFlow capture (--port + --board cyton_daisy), not LSL inlet — direct BrainFlow chosen to avoid LSL inlet jitter on the EEG side per .roadmap.eeg cond.7 daemon listener pattern; LSL is used only for *marker* sync (not EEG samples)

C6: baselines from 2026-05-05 18:56-18:58 used 60s windows (not 5-min spec target); if user wants spec-symmetric baselines, set RECAPTURE_BASELINES=1; otherwise PASS-on-15min-reading-task-alone is the practical path
C7: this BG does not exec the main protocol — user-gated launch only (raw#10 honest scope)

C8: F2 ceiling lift NOT in scope — Phase E PASS only raises F1_v2 raw band toward YELLOW projection 0.408→0.558; n_substrate.blk.1 structural lift is a separate path (b/c learned phi_extractor + N-22 + IIT 4.0 proper phi)
